title: A prime-power unimodular row has a unit coordinate
statement: For natural numbers p and a with p prime and 0 < a, put R = ℤ/p^aℤ. For every r,s ∈ R, there exist x,y ∈ R with xr + ys = 1 if and only if r is a unit or s is a unit.
lean_statement: ∀ (p a : ℕ), p.Prime → 0 < a → ∀ r s : ZMod (p ^ a), (∃ x y : ZMod (p ^ a), x * r + y * s = 1) ↔ IsUnit r ∨ IsUnit s
